title: A wider circle at fixed spin
hook: Change distance from the axle and predict centripetal acceleration.
misconception: centripetal acceleration stays fixed when distance from the axle doubles.
objective: Apply a_c = ω²r to compare centripetal acceleration when distance from the axle changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a rigid turntable with fixed angular speed, a_c = ω²r. When distance from the axle doubles, centripetal acceleration becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model a_c = ω²r; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a rigid turntable with fixed angular speed, with a nonzero initial result. If distance from the axle triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on centripetal acceleration?
recall.why: Apply a_c = ω²r under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
